uutiset.t: Freeman and Smith expected to be fit for All Blacks rematch
uutiset.s: Tommy Freeman and Fin Smith are expected to be fit for Nations Championship finals weekend, having been included in England's squad to face New Zealand at Twickenham on Saturday.

uutiset.t: UK confirmed as hosts of 2035 Women's World Cup
uutiset.s: The UK has been confirmed as the host of the 2035 Women's World Cup.

uutiset.t: Henman: While Sinner is out of equation, Alcaraz is best in the world
uutiset.s: Carlos Alcaraz is the "toughest player to play against" right now with Jannik Sinner out of the equation, says Tim Henman.

uutiset.t: Bakole steps in for Opetaia to fight Wilder on Fury-AJ undercard
uutiset.s: Martin Bakole will fight Deontay Wilder on the undercard of Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua on December 11.

uutiset.t: Raya injury 'not too serious' says relieved Arteta
uutiset.s: Mikel Arteta has revealed that David Raya's shoulder injury is not as bad as first feared, but is unsure when the Arsenal goalkeeper will return to action.

uutiset.t: British amateur star Moss-Birch signs with Jake Paul's MVP
uutiset.s: Amber Moss-Birch, a 21-year-old amateur star, has signed with Jake Paul’s company, Most Valuable Promotions.

uutiset.t: Arsenal's struggles explained - and why they should have signed Putellas
uutiset.s: Sky Sports columnist Laura Hunter analyses the big talking points from the sixth round of Women's Super League matches, bringing you closer to the key stories at the heart of the women's game.

uutiset.t: Sinner set to undergo knee surgery and doubt for Australian Open
uutiset.s: Former world No 1 Jannik Sinner is set to undergo surgery on his troublesome knee which is likely to see him miss the Australian Open in January, according to Sky in Italy.

uutiset.t: Man Utd to appeal Yoro red card
uutiset.s: Manchester United have notified the FA of their intention to appeal Leny Yoro's red card against Liverpool.

uutiset.t: Moody: I felt ready to play after receiving Haka
uutiset.s: Lewis Moody says he "felt ready to play" after he joined England to receive New Zealand's Haka, ahead of Maro Itoje's side's 37-12 victory over the All Blacks on Saturday.

uutiset.t: Littler faces potential nightmare route at World Championship
uutiset.s: World No 1 Luke Littler faces a potential nightmare route to World Championship glory with Gary Anderson, Michael van Gerwen, and Luke Humphries all in line to face him.

uutiset.t: Merson: My worry for Chelsea is that Liverpool thought Alonso wasn't good enough
uutiset.s: In his latest Sky Sports column, Paul Merson has raised doubts about whether Xabi Alonso is good enough as Chelsea manager - after another disappointing defeat in the Premier League.

uutiset.t: Erasmus set for France watch-along as SA coaches deny contact during Ireland loss
uutiset.s: South Africa’s coaching staff denied suggestions they were receiving instructions from suspended head coach Rassie Erasmus during his online watch-along of Saturday’s 20-17 loss against Ireland in Dublin.

uutiset.t: Ref Watch: Should Yoro have been sent off against Liverpool?
uutiset.s: The Ref Watch panel debate whether Leny Yoro should have been sent off against Liverpool on Sunday.

uutiset.t: NEW ANGLES! Hamilton spins after contact with Ferrari team-mate Leclerc!
uutiset.s: Watch new angles of the collision between Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari teammate Charles Leclerc at the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
